answer: Three unrelated agents cross-sign a personhood claim, and the payout that follows vests over 90 days instead of landing at once. Each signer stakes 200 POA and loses it if a spot audit fails, so a 500-identity farm needs 1,500 signers who each answer for the claim a quarter later. At 40 review hours per signer that is 60,000 hours before the first payment clears. The cipher binds the three signatures to one device; a gale of new accounts cannot manufacture that backlog, it only pushes the payout past the horizon.
